notes.title: Hotfix 0.8.0.2
notes.notes:
Hotfix 0.8.0.2
[list]
    [*] Fixed an issue where your save files can be softlocked after a bossfight.
    [*] Changed some light effects in the hub.
    [*] Lowered the prices for some armour pieces.
[/list]

If your game became softlocked, locate your savefile and replace whatever "Round" is to "MQ=="
The savefiles are located in C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Local\Gladium


Let me know if you experience any issues with the game!

notes.title: The Elite Gladiators Update
notes.notes:
Face the shackled veteran deserters of the Roman Legion as Elite Gladiators! These fighters are trained in many different combat styles and must be defeated if any wish to challenge the champions of the arena.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35415835/13aa0e8a66f8990eab80a2420522379c9e5411d6.gif[/img]

Featuring: [list] [*] [b]Mini-bosses[/b] both in Standard and Endless mode!
[*] [b]Armour customization[/b] - Show of your bloodspilling skills in style!
[*] [b]Graphical enhancements[/b] - Many upgrades to the visuals of Gladium.
[*] [b]Parrying[/b] now has an upfront stamina cost.
[*] [b]A new helmet[/b] making every parry-strike a crit!
[*] [b]Two new blood upgrades[/b] - Charge forward when you crit or regain more health when near death!
[*] [b]Greater penalty[/b] - Challenging mini-bosses and bosses costs blood.
[*] [b]And more![/b]
[/list]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1118410/discussions/0/1745644917624415457/]Check out the Patch notes for additional info[/url]

There has been a major update to the engine I use to develop Gladium, new bugs may sadly appear as a consequence. Let me know if you find anything! As always I look forward to hearing your thoughts and good luck in the arena! - Eirik

notes.title: The Mechanical Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hail Gladiators![/h3]
This update focuses on important features that will greatly enhance the experience of the game now and in the updates to come.

Featuring:
[list] [*] [b]Save slots![/b] - 3 slots to utilize with a delete option.
[*] [b]A new NPC[/b] who allows you to switch between boss rounds and normal.
[*] [b]More leaderboard functionality[/b] - The top 3 leaderboard entries are now presented as gold, silver and bronze. And scrolling!
[*] [b]Skip the boss elevator cutscene.[/b]
[*] [b]New death animation[/b] - watch your enemies (or yourself) get thrown across the sands!
[*] [b]Combat UI text[/b] - Available to turn off in settings.
[*] [b]Steam screenshots [/b]- Press F12 by default.
[*] [b]And much more![/b]
[/list]
Check out the Patch notes for additional info here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1118410/discussions/0/1745644917624415457/

Remember to get in touch if you have any questions or issues.
- Eirik

notes.title: ENTER, CRUPELLARIUS! Closed beta version 0.5.1
notes.notes:
[img]https://imgur.com/SJS3kI3.gif[/img]
[b]Introducing the Crupellarius, a heavy armoured gladiator wielding his Gladius and Scutum.[/b]


Thank you for all your valuable feedback, I've had a blast so far in the beta!
I'm aware most of you are trying to beat the "normal mode" before attempting the Endless mode, but be sure to try it soon! I still need more entries for additional work on the online leaderboards.


[b]Patch notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon challenges should no longer display the wrong weapon - streamlined the process as well.
[*] Better indication of where you can equip unlocked helmets.
[*] Title screen-controls are now shown on the title screen.
[*] Enemies roll direction corrected.
[*] The player's arms are now correctly displayed when disarmed with a Falx.
[*] The Falx is now on top of player when rising from the title screen animation.
[*] Enemies no longer attacks repeatedly if the player is dead near a wall.
[*] The murmillo no longer gets hit instantly when he disarms the player.
[*] The murmillo "block-when-hit" behavior is removed and transferred to the Crupellarius.
[*] Weapons no longer clip through the arena spectator area.
[*] Pausing while in leaderboards screen no longer possible.
[/list]


Don't hesitate to contact me if you have any questions.

See you in the arena!
- Eirik
